_doc: Banked counts of react-hooks/exhaustive-deps and react-hooks/set-state-in-effect SUPPRESSIONS. Written by scripts/check-hook-suppression-ratchet.mjs --update. The ratchet fails on any rise AND on any unbanked fall — see that script's header for why an error-count lint baseline is structurally unable to record this class.

.._note: packages/ only. Six exhaustive-deps suppression sites: data-grid 3, page-builder 1, schema-registry 1, ui 1. PR3246 removes two obsolete data-grid callback suppressions. Independently enumerated by --list . and full seven-scope CI job102456477769; the parent itself still configures no react-hooks rules. Other scope baselines are unchanged.

crm7._note: The estate's largest holding, and the one whose real size was never visible: 51 inline exhaustive-deps comments spread thinly over src/pages (no file above 2), PLUS 92 file-level suppressions declared in eslint.config.js — EXHAUSTIVE_DEPS_FILES (4) and SET_STATE_IN_EFFECT_FILES (88). NOTE: that config's own header comment says 'set-state-in-effect (80 files)'. The array holds 88. The prose register drifted 8 behind the array it describes, which is precisely why this ratchet counts the array and not the comment. Triage for the 92 is in crm7/eslint.config.js lines 70-150 and bsuite#215.

conduit._note: 4 inline exhaustive-deps, and — far more significant — a repository-wide `'react-hooks/set-state-in-effect': 'off'` at eslint.config.mjs:117 in a config object with no `files:` key. That is not 1 suppression, it is an unbounded licence over all 424 source files, and it is the single highest-value item in this baseline to retire. Scoping it to a `files:` list would convert it into a countable, shrinkable number.

business-suite-unified._note: Evenly split 3/3. The set-state-in-effect three are magicui vendored animation components (animated-grid-pattern, typing-animation) plus platform/PageEditorLauncher; the typing-animation one is a `/* eslint-disable */.../* eslint-enable */` block pair, counted once at the disable. BSU sets set-state-in-effect to 'error' repo-wide, so these are genuine exceptions against an armed rule.

braden._note: 4 inline exhaustive-deps across src/hooks (2), src/components/magicui (1), src/components/content/hooks (1). set-state-in-effect is 'error' repo-wide with zero suppressions — the cleanest scope with the rule actually armed.

throughput._note: 24 set-state-in-effect + 1 exhaustive-deps, every one carrying a `-- reason` suffix (mostly 'bootstrap async fetch on mount' and 'sync prop->state'). eslint.config.js:118 claims 'All set-state-in-effect findings resolved via real refactors' immediately above setting the rule to 'error' — 24 inline suppressions say otherwise. The reasons are honest and several are legitimate; the claim above them is not.

R80.4._note: Zero, and the zero is UNENFORCED, not clean: R80.4/eslint.config.mjs configures no react-hooks rules at all across 11 .tsx files. Nothing here is switched on to suppress. Arming the rules here is the follow-up that would make this number mean something; until then, treat it as unmeasured rather than as evidence.
